notifications.title: Set up notifications
notifications.description: Get notifications about schedules and activity in Zyx.
notifications.instruction: Set your notification preference, then finish the tour.
notifications.registering: Setting up notifications for this device…
notifications.ready: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.deniedBrowser: Your browser has blocked notifications. Allow them in the site settings, then check again.
notifications.deniedDevice: Your device has blocked notifications. Allow notifications for Zyx in your device settings, then check again.
notifications.unsupported: Notifications are unavailable in this browser or on this device. You can still finish the tour.
notifications.registrationFailed: Permission is granted, but Zyx could not set up notifications. Try again.
notifications.transportInactive: Permission is granted, but the notification service is not active yet. Check again or finish the tour.
notifications.requestFailed: The permission request did not succeed. Try again.
notifications.permissionRequiredBrowser: Select Enable notifications, then allow them when your browser asks.
notifications.permissionRequiredDevice: Select Enable notifications, then allow them on your device.
